title.value: NG TB Community and Facility Referral Register

description.value: Logical model for the Nigeria National Tuberculosis and Leprosy Control Programme Tuberculosis Referral Register for Community and Facility. One model instance represents one site-level monthly referral register and contains repeatable client entries covering demographics, referral date and reason, receiving facility, confirmation of TB, treatment initiation and remarks.

name.value: NG TB Community and Facility Referral Register Column Mapping

comment.value: Maps NgTBCommunityFacilityReferralRegister logical-model elements to the printed Tuberculosis Referral Register for Community and Facility.

short.value: NG TB Community and Facility Referral Register

One client-level referral row in the community and facility TB referral register.
